Townhouse for Rent | Topanga, The Park Villas, DAMAC Hills

Provident Real Estate is pleased to present this well-maintained 3-bedroom plus maid’s townhouse located in the highly sought-after Topanga community within The Park Villas, DAMAC Hills. The area is known for its lush green surroundings, family-oriented lifestyle, and access to the Trump International Golf Club Dubai.

The villa features a practical and well-designed layout with bright living and dining areas that open seamlessly to the outdoor space. All bedrooms are generously sized, making the home ideal for comfortable family living. Offered unfurnished, the property allows tenants to personalize the interiors to suit their preferences.

Property Details:

Location: Topanga, The Park Villas, DAMAC Hills, Dubai
Property Type: Townhouse Villa
Bedrooms: 3
Maid’s Room: Yes
Layout: THM1
Built-Up Area: 2,249 sq. ft.
Plot Area: 2725.53 sq. ft.
Furnishing: Unfurnished
Annual Rent: AED 210,000

Residents of DAMAC Hills benefit from access to parks, walking trails, retail outlets, dining options, and premium leisure facilities, making it an excellent choice for families and professionals.

For further details or to arrange a viewing, please contact us today.
